verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench is a set of free web tools (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators). A buyer could reasonably ask whether such a web service lets users opt out of tracking, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry, analytics or cookie opt-out. The Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity page describes a legal practice for clients, not a user-facing control in the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
